evidence.subject: model_world_partition
evidence.semantics: Deliberately fixed [-131072,131072] inclusive XY envelope with 32 by 32 row-major 8192-unit cells; it is not an authoritative terrain boundary.

evidence.subject: reported_metadata_containment
evidence.semantics: All 63 exact supported replay/build/world records report finite metadata extents contained by the engineered envelope; their conflicting tuples and failed canonicalization remain diagnostics.

evidence.subject: model_visible_coordinate_coverage
evidence.semantics: Coverage-only audit of player samples, player events, team centroids, zone-phase source and target centers, and sampled current and target zone centers. Coordinates never define or expand the envelope.

evidence.subject: axis_mapping
evidence.semantics: Raw X maps to columns and raw Y to rows; increasing values increase indices; exact maximum bounds map to the final cell.

evidence.subject: world_unit_scale
evidence.semantics: One Unreal meter is 100 world units, so one world unit is 0.01 meters.

evidence.subject: coordinate_system
evidence.semantics: Unreal world coordinates are Cartesian with a fixed world-space origin.
